ideas.pitch: A real-time competitive coding platform featuring synchronized problem solving and dynamic live leaderboards.
ideas.problem_statement: Published problem context: Overview: ELUCode is a fast-paced 2-hour competitive coding contest by EduLinkUp designed to challenge your problem-solving ability, algorithmic thinking, and coding speed.
ideas.title: AlgoDuet
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly mirrors the core spirit of the ELUCode contest, focusing heavily on accurate leaderboard calculation and tie-breaking by solution timestamp.

ideas.pitch: A sandboxed code evaluation microservice that automatically tests participant submissions against hidden and visible test cases.
ideas.problem_statement: Published problem context: Scoring: Each challenge carries a predefined score, based on its difficulty level. A participant’s score for a challenge depends on the number of test cases successfully passed by their submission.
ideas.title: CodeJudge-Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves the exact automated grading and test case verification mechanics required for competitive coding infrastructure.

ideas.pitch: An algorithmic performance tracker that analyzes submission timelines and tie-breaker metrics for coding contests.
ideas.problem_statement: Published problem context: If two or more participants achieve the same score, the tie will be broken based on the sum of time of the first correct solution for all the problems.
ideas.title: SpeedCode Analytics
ideas.why_it_could_win: Provides precise automated analytics matching the strict tie-breaking criteria of the contest scoring engine.

ideas.pitch: An automated certificate and achievement badge generation tool tailored for competitive programming winners.
ideas.problem_statement: Published problem context: Top performers will be recognised through special achievement badges and certificates within the EduLinkUp ecosystem.
ideas.title: EduLinkUp Badge Issuer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses the ecosystem reward requirement by providing instant, verifiable digital credentials for top performers.

ideas.pitch: An algorithmic problem curator that creates varied difficulty logic puzzles and test case bundles for competitive programming.
ideas.problem_statement: Published problem context: Participants will face multiple problems of varying difficulty levels, testing their understanding of data structures, algorithms, logic building, and efficient coding practices.
ideas.title: LogicPuzzle Generator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates practical utility in curating and structuring test suites and difficulty scaling for fast-paced coding contests.
